explanation: This fires only at D1 and is about 10 when the previous trial was a1 that went rarely to S2 and got rewarded; it is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and 0 after any a2 trial. At D1 after an unrewarded a1 trial in the first ~40 trials of an a1 streak it is sometimes around 5-7, but usually 0; every other D1 is 0.
